answer: Each epoch the ledger pages keys at an unpredictable time. The key must answer live at a single serialized intake jetty within 90 seconds, attaching a one-shot walnut commitment over the epoch beacon that cannot be precomputed. A miss freezes payouts for a 12-epoch glacier window and slashes 50 POA of posted bond. One operator can cover only a few live windows at once, so a 100-key farm misses most pages and burns more in slashes than honest emission can repay.
